notes: Flags: none. Fit: the bathroom list, towel hooks: one 3-pack, one hook each, with Maddie's at her height. Self-adhesive, so no drilling into a rental's tile, but "The adhesive tape can leave marks when the product is removed." and "Do not attach the hook to bathroom wallpaper or other plastic surfaces". Max. load 4.4 lb per hook (a wet bath towel weighs less). Aluminum, chrome plated (not black, which the house keeps for lamps). Price $6.99 per 3-pack. Variant: chrome plated. Popularity: the SKOGHALL search card carried Best seller (#2 and #3 under a search for "towel hook"); the chrome page shows no badge.
